summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests passing (100%) including all new endpoints (holdings, holdings/recommendations, cibil, upcoming-transactions, budget/auto, milestones CRUD) plus auth-required guards. Frontend: CIBIL card on Home (782/Excellent), NetWorth life-timeline chart with 4 default milestones plotted on Age 30->60 curve, 16 holdings cards with XIRR vs benchmark, Gold/Silver live prices (Rs 7,240 / Rs 92,500) and 30d change, AI Holdings Advisor (5 cards: Gold/Silver/MF switch/Bonds/Allocation) — all verified. Add Milestone dialog opens, accepts input, plots TEST_Vacation on timeline successfully. Connect-broker toast and Apply buttons work.

integration_issues.issue: Playwright assertion read 0 upcoming rows likely due to test race-condition (calendar grid container renders before /transactions and /upcoming-transactions API responses arrive). API itself returns 13 items in backend tests. Recommend Profile/AI Budget Builder dialog and upcoming-transactions panel to be re-verified manually or with a wait-for-data hook by main agent.

issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings repeatedly in console — ResponsiveContainer parents likely lack explicit min-height/aspect; cosmetic but noisy.

action_items: (Optional) Re-verify Profile -> AI Budget Builder Re-run/Accept flow manually — could not be completed by automated test due to earlier upcoming-rows race-condition stopping the script.
(Optional) Add aria-describedby to DialogContent in NetWorth Add Milestone modal to silence a11y warning.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 918 lines — exceeds the 700-line module guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (auth.py, networth.py, holdings.py, milestones.py, ai.py) for maintainability.

HOLDINGS_TEMPLATE, CIBIL score, and upcoming-transactions are static constants returned per-request — fine for current MVP but flagged as MOCKED in problem statement. Confirmed labeled 'Connect broker for live XIRR' on UI.
/api/cibil 'history' uses random.randint each call — score will jitter on every refresh which is non-deterministic UX. Consider seeding/persisting once per user.
/api/milestones GET seeds defaults inside a GET (side-effect on read). Consider seeding at signup like other defaults to keep GET idempotent.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (CIBIL, holdings, advisor, milestones add verified; upcoming-tx + budget-builder dialog blocked by test race condition, not by app bugs)

seed_data_creation: test_finpilot_api.py creates a TEST_<uuid>@finpilot.ai user via /auth/signup which auto-seeds 11 accounts/55 txns/3 goals/budget. Iteration-2 milestones test creates and deletes TEST_Vacation milestone.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend covered by /app/backend/tests/test_finpilot_api.py (28 tests, all passing). For frontend Transactions/Profile pages with API-dependent content, prefer waiting on a stable data indicator (e.g. wait_for_function checking row count > 0) rather than just the section container, to avoid races. Demo user reseed uses random charges so transaction merchants/amounts vary, but all Iteration-2 endpoints return deterministic shapes.
rca of the issue: Frontend test reported 0 upcoming-rows because Playwright assertion executed immediately after [data-testid=upcoming-transactions] container appeared. This container renders unconditionally even before /upcoming-transactions resolves. Mitigation in next test run: await page.wait_for_function('document.querySelectorAll("[data-testid^=upcoming-row-]").length > 0', timeout=10000) before counting.
